content.text:
Read-only audit complete; no files changed.

## Release blockers

- Versioning is untouched: root, web, mobile, browser runtime, and `src/core/version.ts` remain `2.10.0`. Neither changelog has a 3.0.0 entry.
- The index is incomplete: only `Landing.tsx` and an older version of `SurfaceScreencasts.tsx` are staged; the latter is `AM`, with substantial unstaged additions.
- `usePersistedSettings()` passes loaders returning freshly parsed objects to `useSyncExternalStore`. This violates React’s stable snapshot requirement and can cause repeated renders/infinite-loop warnings. Affects both model and UI settings.
- Pear course projection is not clearly share-safe. `projectCourseForPear()` retains full member/owner account IDs, display names, material/card/note author IDs, comments, and identifiers on shared submissions. Anyone receiving the replicable feed key can retain that data. Requires an explicit privacy/redaction decision.
- Landing media is stale for 3.0.0: several posters visibly say `v2.10.0`; `feature-live`, `feature-coming-up`, `feature-courses`, and `feature-publish` visibly include the Playwriter toolbar. The publishing poster advertises a currently unavailable blog.
- `/blog` now replaces the checked-in legacy blog with AT Protocol records. Without publishing the historical records and setting deployment variables, production shows an unavailable state.
- Task names changed from unnamespaced devenv tasks to `keating:*`, but stale `just`/old-task instructions remain in `mobile/README.md`, `src/cli/web.ts`, multiple VHS tapes, `web/src/pages/Blog.tsx`, and repository guidance.

## Intended product/release files

- Structured collaborative TUI: `src/tui/{host-controller,opentui-host,view-model}.ts` and tests.
- Courses/Pear: `packages/p2p-core/src/{index,course-feed}.ts`; `web/src/courses/**`; course pages/components; server API/repository/realtime/session/Pear gateway; Nitro config and tests.
- Coming Up/Anki: `ComingUp.tsx`, `coming-up.ts`, `anki-package.ts`, storage/schema changes, package dependencies, and tests.
- Live transcript, image retry/model choice, capability filters, settings hooks, navigation, artifact UI refactors, and associated stories/tests.
